# ── Cell 1: Config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER       = "mundra-ct04"

OLD_SILVER_PATH = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/ecevents"
NEW_SILVER_PATH = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/ecevents2/"

MERGE_KEY         = "ec_event_gkey"
SENTINEL_DISTANCE = 100_000_000

OVERLAP_MODE = "skip"    # "skip": keep new-silver rows as-is | "fill_nulls": fill only NULL target cols from old
DRY_RUN      = True      # True = checks only, no write

# Only used if the old timestamp is still a string (Data Flow formats)
OLD_TS_FORMATS = [
    "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss", "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",
    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", "dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss", "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss",
    "dd/MM/yyyy'T'HH:mm:ss",
]

assert OLD_SILVER_PATH.rstrip("/") != NEW_SILVER_PATH.rstrip("/"), "Old and new silver paths are the same"
assert "/silver/ecevents" in OLD_SILVER_PATH and "/silver/ecevents" in NEW_SILVER_PATH

# ── Cell 2: Read old + new, map old -> new ────────────────────────────────────
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

assert DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, NEW_SILVER_PATH), \
    "New silver table not found - run EcEvents_CT04 first."

old        = spark.read.format("delta").load(OLD_SILVER_PATH)
target     = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, NEW_SILVER_PATH)
tgt_schema = target.toDF().schema
tgt_cols   = [f.name for f in tgt_schema]

_old_lc    = {c.lower(): c for c in old.columns}
_old_types = dict(old.dtypes)

# new silver column : ([old column candidates, first found wins], kind)
MAPPING = {
    "ec_event_gkey"       : (["ecEventGkey"],            "long"),
    "yard_gkey"           : (["yardGkey"],               "long"),
    "yard_id"             : (["YardID"],                 "str"),
    "facility_id"         : (["FcyID"],                  "str"),
    "che_kind"            : (["cheKind"],                "str"),
    "che_name"            : (["CHE_Name"],               "str"),
    "che_id"              : (["cheID", "CHE_ID"],        "id"),
    "event_ts"            : (["EcEventTime", "TimeStamp"], "ts"),
    "event_type"          : (["eventType"],              "int"),
    "event_sub_type"      : (["eventSubType"],           "int"),
    "event_type_desc"     : (["eventTypeDescription"],   "str"),
    "from_che"            : (["fromCheIdName"],          "idz"),
    "to_che"              : (["ToCheIdName"],            "idz"),
    "unit_nbrs"           : (["unit"],                   "str"),
    "pow"                 : (["pow"],                    "str"),
    "pool"                : (["pool"],                   "str"),
    "work_queue"          : (["workQueue"],              "str"),
    "travel_distance"     : (["travelDistance"],         "dec"),
    "move_kind"           : (["moveKind"],               "str"),
    "is_twin"             : (["isTwin"],                 "flag"),
    "start_distance"      : (["startDistance"],          "dec"),
    "work_assignment_gkey": (["workAssignment"],         "long"),
    "unit_ref"            : (["unitRef"],                "str"),
    "tran_id"             : (["tran_ID"],                "str"),
    "loc_type"            : (["locType"],                "str"),
    "loc_id"              : (["locID"],                  "str"),
    "loc_slot"            : (["locSlot"],                "str"),
    "ops_pos_id"          : (["opsPosID"],               "str"),
    "unladen_loc_type"    : (["unladenLoctype"],         "str"),
    "unladen_loc_id"      : (["unladenLocID"],           "str"),
    "unladen_loc_slot"    : (["unladenLocSlot"],         "str"),
    "laden_loc_type"      : (["ladenLoctype"],           "str"),
    "laden_loc_id"        : (["ladenLocID"],             "str"),
    "laden_loc_slot"      : (["laden_LocSlot"],          "str"),
    "operator_name"       : (["OPERATOR_ID", "operator_name"], "id"),
}

_TRUE  = ["YES", "Y", "TRUE", "1", "1.0"]
_FALSE = ["NO",  "N", "FALSE", "0", "0.0"]
_NUMERIC = ("tinyint", "smallint", "int", "bigint", "float", "double", "decimal")

def conv(c, kind, dtype):
    is_num = dtype.startswith(_NUMERIC)
    s = F.trim(c.cast("string"))
    if kind == "str":
        return F.when(s == "", None).otherwise(s)
    if kind in ("id", "idz"):
        # numeric -> through decimal so a double never becomes '1.23E7'
        base = F.trim(c.cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("string")) if is_num else s
        t = F.regexp_replace(base, r"\.0+$", "")
        bad = ["", "0"] if kind == "idz" else [""]
        return F.when(t.isin(*bad), None).otherwise(t)
    if kind in ("long", "int"):
        src = c if is_num else s
        return src.cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("bigint" if kind == "long" else "int")
    if kind == "dec":
        return (c if is_num else s).cast("decimal(18,3)")
    if kind == "ts":
        if dtype.startswith("timestamp"):
            return c.cast("timestamp")
        return F.coalesce(*[F.to_timestamp(s, f) for f in OLD_TS_FORMATS])
    if kind == "flag":
        u = F.upper(s)
        return (F.when(u.isin(_TRUE), F.lit(1)).when(u.isin(_FALSE), F.lit(0))
                 .otherwise(None).cast("byte"))
    raise ValueError(kind)

exprs, missing_old, used_old = {}, [], set()
for new_name, (candidates, kind) in MAPPING.items():
    real = next((_old_lc[c.lower()] for c in candidates if c.lower() in _old_lc), None)
    if real is None:
        missing_old.append(f"{new_name} <- {candidates}")
        continue
    used_old.add(real)
    exprs[new_name] = conv(F.col(f"`{real}`"), kind, _old_types[real])

print(f"Old rows                        : {old.count():,}")
print(f"Mapped columns                  : {len(exprs)}")
print(f"Not found in old                : {missing_old}")
print(f"Old columns dropped             : {[c for c in old.columns if c not in used_old]}")
print(f"Target cols NULL / derived      : {[c for c in tgt_cols if c not in exprs]}")

# ── Cell 3: Transform exactly like EcEvents_CT04 ──────────────────────────────
YARD_SLOT_RE = r"^(\d?[A-Z]{1,2})(\d{2,3})([A-Z])\.(\d{1,2})$"

def add_slot_parts(df, col, prefix):
    c = F.col(col)
    def part(i):
        v = F.regexp_extract(c, YARD_SLOT_RE, i)
        return F.when(v == "", None).otherwise(v)
    return (df.withColumn(f"{prefix}_block", part(1))
              .withColumn(f"{prefix}_bay",   part(2))
              .withColumn(f"{prefix}_row",   part(3))
              .withColumn(f"{prefix}_tier",  part(4).cast("smallint")))

staged = old.select(*[e.alias(n) for n, e in exprs.items()])

for dist_col in ["travel_distance", "start_distance"]:
    if dist_col in staged.columns:
        staged = staged.withColumn(
            dist_col, F.when(F.col(dist_col) >= F.lit(SENTINEL_DISTANCE), None).otherwise(F.col(dist_col)))

units = F.split(F.col("unit_nbrs"), ";")
staged = (staged
    .withColumn("event_date", F.to_date("event_ts"))
    .withColumn("unit_1",     F.trim(units.getItem(0)))
    .withColumn("unit_2",     F.trim(units.getItem(1)))
    .withColumn("unit_count", F.when(F.col("unit_nbrs").isNull(), None).otherwise(F.size(units))))
for col, prefix in [("loc_slot", "loc"), ("unladen_loc_slot", "unladen"), ("laden_loc_slot", "laden")]:
    if col in staged.columns:
        staged = add_slot_parts(staged, col, prefix)

# One row per key (latest event_ts)
staged = staged.filter(F.col(MERGE_KEY).isNotNull())
w = Window.partitionBy(MERGE_KEY).orderBy(F.col("event_ts").desc_nulls_last())
staged = staged.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w)).filter("_rn = 1").drop("_rn")

# Conform to target schema: same columns/order/types, missing -> typed NULL
HASH_EXCLUDE = {"row_hash", "_silver_loaded_at"}
aligned = staged.select(*[
    (F.col(f.name) if f.name in staged.columns else F.lit(None)).cast(f.dataType).alias(f.name)
    for f in tgt_schema if f.name not in HASH_EXCLUDE
])
aligned = (aligned
    .withColumn("row_hash", F.xxhash64(*[F.col(c) for c in aligned.columns]))
    .withColumn("_silver_loaded_at", F.current_timestamp())
    .select(*tgt_cols)
    .persist())

print(f"Staged rows (deduped): {aligned.count():,}")
print(f"Null event_ts        : {aligned.filter(F.col('event_ts').isNull()).count():,}")

# ── Cell 4: Diagnostics (overlap, timestamp seconds, distance clipping) ───────
tgt_df = target.toDF()

print("Old event_date range:", aligned.agg(F.min("event_date"), F.max("event_date")).collect()[0])
print("New event_date range:", tgt_df.agg(F.min("event_date"), F.max("event_date")).collect()[0])

ov = (aligned.select(MERGE_KEY, F.col("event_ts").alias("ts_old"))
      .join(tgt_df.select(MERGE_KEY, F.col("event_ts").alias("ts_new")), MERGE_KEY))
n_ov   = ov.count()
n_diff = ov.filter(~F.col("ts_old").eqNullSafe(F.col("ts_new"))).count()
print(f"Overlapping keys: {n_ov:,} | rows to insert: {aligned.count() - n_ov:,}")
print(f"Overlap rows where event_ts differs: {n_diff:,}")
if n_diff:
    display(ov.filter(~F.col("ts_old").eqNullSafe(F.col("ts_new")))
              .withColumn("diff_sec", F.unix_timestamp("ts_new") - F.unix_timestamp("ts_old"))
              .limit(20))

# Seconds truncated? (share of timestamps on a whole minute)
def sec0_share(df):
    r = df.agg(F.avg((F.second("event_ts") == 0).cast("double"))).collect()[0][0]
    return round((r or 0) * 100, 1)
print(f"% event_ts with seconds = 0 -> old: {sec0_share(aligned)}% | new: {sec0_share(tgt_df)}%  (~1.7% is normal)")

# Distance clipping from the old 'short' projection
display(aligned.agg(
    F.count("*").alias("rows"),
    F.sum(F.col("travel_distance").isNull().cast("int")).alias("travel_null"),
    F.max("travel_distance").alias("travel_max"),
    F.sum(F.col("start_distance").isNull().cast("int")).alias("start_null"),
    F.max("start_distance").alias("start_max")))
display(tgt_df.agg(F.max("travel_distance").alias("new_travel_max"),
                   F.max("start_distance").alias("new_start_max")))

# ── Cell 6: Post-check + release the session ──────────────────────────────────
result = spark.read.format("delta").load(NEW_SILVER_PATH)
print(f"Rows: {result.count():,}")
print("Duplicate keys:", result.groupBy(MERGE_KEY).count().filter("count > 1").count())
display(result.groupBy(F.year("event_date").alias("yr"), F.month("event_date").alias("mo"))
              .count().orderBy("yr", "mo"))

mssparkutils.session.stop()
